pages.text: $(bold)Continuity protocol: active.$()$(br2)After equipment loss in late Phase 6, the Emergency EVA supplies:$(li)10 minutes of reserve oxygen$(li)15 minutes of equipped thermal service
Missing suit components are issued automatically upon return.

This equipment is disposable. One service clock is shared by every issued piece.$(br2)Recover a serviceable rig or return to recorded shelter.$(br2)$(italic)Recorded locations do not constitute confirmation of habitable conditions.$()

pages.title: Navigation
pages.text: Press $(k:key.frozendawn.continuity_target) to switch the target.$(br2)$(bold)LAST SHELTER:$() recorded when you set your respawn at a bed or charged anchor. The fix is degraded: follow the bearing, then search within 32 blocks. It stays the same across replacement issues.

$(bold)LAST TELEMETRY:$() where your equipment was lost. It records a position, not whether the equipment is still there. Later empty-handed emergency losses keep the original destination.$(br2)Equipment from the qualifying loss lasts 15 minutes while its area is ticking. Fire, lava and other hazards still apply.

pages.title: Service Limits
pages.text: $(li)Inventory bars show equipped service power$(li)The HUD timer appears at 5 minutes left$(li)Breathable air saves oxygen; service power keeps counting$(li)Impacts injure you but do not shorten service$(li)Seal wear shows at the visor edges

$(bold)At zero:$() thermal control, navigation and emergency armor end, and the issued pieces are removed.$(br2)A complete sealed normal EVA rig with usable oxygen retires the emergency issue at once.
Removing every issued piece pauses service and its life support. Repair, cartridges and replacement issues cannot refresh old equipment.
